metadata.question: Did sea surface temperatures in the Arabian Sea reach at least 30 degrees Celcius in June of 2023?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: NOAA/CDO/OISST/V2_1 (Sea Surface Temperature) or HYCOM data - Date: June 2023 (2023-06-01 to 2023-06-30) - Location: Arabian Sea (approximate bounds: 10-25°N, 55-75°E) 2. Masking strategy: - SST data typically doesn't need cloud masking - Check for valid data pixels (not masked/null values) 3. Logic: - Valid result: If max SST >= 30°C → Answer A, else → Answer B - C1: No images in collection for June 2023 - C2: All pixels masked/invalid after processing - C3: Result is None/NaN or unrealistic (e.g., >50°C or <-5°C for SST) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Arabian Sea geometry const arabianSea = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[55, 10], [75, 10], [75, 25], [55, 25], [55, 10]] ]); // 2. Define time period const startDate = '2023-06-01'; const endDate = '2023-06-30'; // 3. Load SST data let sstCollection = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/CDO/OISST/V2_1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(arabianSea); const collectionSize = sstCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`SST Images found: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("No SST data available for June 2023 in Arabian Sea."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 4. Get maximum SST across the time period const maxSST = sstCollection.select('sst').max(); // 5. Calculate statistics const stats = maxSST.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.max().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: arabianSea, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const maxTemp = stats.sst_max; const pixelCount = stats.sst_count; console.log(`Valid pixels: ${pixelCount}`); console.log(`Maximum SST: ${maxTemp !== null ? maxTemp.toFixed(2) : 'null'}°C`); // 6. Validation and answer if (pixelCount === 0 || pixelCount === null) { console.log("No valid pixels after processing."); console.log("C2"); return; } if (maxTemp === null || maxTemp === undefined || isNaN(maxTemp)) { console.log("Calculation failed - invalid result."); console.log("C3"); return; } // SST sanity check (should be between -5 and 45°C) if (maxTemp < -5 || maxTemp > 45) { console.log("Unrealistic SST value detected."); console.log("C3"); return; } // 7. Final answer if (maxTemp >= 30.0) { console.log("SST reached at least 30°C in Arabian Sea during June 2023."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("SST did not reach 30°C in Arabian Sea during June 2023."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
